messages:
Mia: FYI I'm seeing a p95 increase on host parse + tokenization for hosted API after yesterday's kernel-routing change. Numbers: ~8-12% higher tail across p95/p99 for 512 seq.

Devin: ack. which build? saw some KV hit rate drift in telemetry last night. can you paste perf sample?

Mia: build 2026-03-19T22:40 -> image hash abc123. stacktrace-ish: host_preparse -> tokenize_shim -> grpc_writev path. simple perf sample (hotpath wall time bucket):
```
wall 1000us
sys   450us  host_preparse::parse_one
user  350us  tokenize_shim::tokenize
user  200us  grpc::writev
```

Sam: thanks — ran quick hotspot. Kernel selector now prefers smallwrite-optimized kernels for batches <4 but that makes proto marshalling do extra copies. KV cache hit rate drop ~3% for these flows which increases decode work.

Lena: hmm the batching heuristic was tuned for latency but we didn't account for preflight tokenization cost. propose: bump threshold to 6 for smallwrite kernel, and enable manual KV prefetch for hot prefix. low-risk canary? :thinking_face: 

Devin: agree. canary patch prepared in branch: release/host-preflight-kernel-2026-03
Devin: patch diff:
```
- if batch_size < 4: use_smallwrite()
+ if batch_size < 6 && not hot_prefix: use_smallwrite()
```

Mia: ran local canary on dev farm — p95 dropped back ~6%, KV hit restored by ~2%. regression not fully erased but much better.

ops-bot: deploy started: canary rollout to 5% traffic at 2026-03-20T15:12Z

Sam: also adding micro-benchmark for serialize-copy count and grpc writev coalescing; will post results.

Lena: filing follow-up perf ticket (#PROF-2387) with reproducer and test vectors. linking the barrel tests here when ready.

Mia: thanks all. ping me when canary hits 50% so I can run load curves + kv heatmap.

Devin: will update status here and mark canary complete or rollback by 2026-03-20T18:00Z.
